summary: Requested a repeat of the newest and thinnest finding's experiment. The claim that an FSM implementing both BatchingFSM and ConfigurationStore never receives StoreConfiguration rests on one execution with a single case per interface; the source interaction is deterministic (runFSM chooses the batched path once and that path never calls StoreConfiguration), but the recorded zero and six also depend on the change committing, on the cluster helper's transports and on the shared recorder, so a second clean-copy execution is the cheap check that those counts are stable rather than an artifact of one run. The retest re-executes experiment 1995fd2023c948c99b650dce1b597cd6-experiment unchanged, and the account stands as recorded until its receipt exists. If the repeat confirms the counts I would cite it in that question's executions and note in the Fact that two executions agree; if it does not, the account would be corrected rather than defended. The separate question of whether AddNonvoter or RemoveServer take the same path is left open, since those change the trigger rather than test reproducibility.
